The Longshot kick pass is not shipped yet, because the ship queue is blocked. The kick is the Longshot going from 4.5 to 7.0, about 1.9 to about 4.1 px of camera kick. Every shipped gun (shotgun, smg, pistol, rifle, magnum, lmg) and the three common enemies (crawler, raider, sentry) already had their feel pass.

- **Old check:** I retargeted check 30.35 so it accepts a Longshot kick of 4.5 or 7. It passes and is committed as b35dec5c. This was the only failure preflight had found.
- **Draft:** I rewrote `mk-cw-kicksniper.ps1`'s draft, and preflight printed PREFLIGHT PASS as v30.68.
- **Ship attempt 1:** It stopped on two older checks, 30.12 (controls card title) and 30.10 (action name colour). The control Chrome also timed out. I didn't touch those screens, so I think the other lanes' work caused it. I haven't confirmed that.
- **Ship attempts 2 and 3:** Both stopped with "gen-draft failed". `tools/handoff/p3069.ps1` and several sibling files are tracked in git but deleted in the working tree. It looks like a race between failed-ship cleanups and the v30.69 ship, and I can't restore files. Every other lane's ship (cw-glyphs2, cw-hudstar, cw-title-fight, cw-p1p2mate) stops the same way.

I logged this as URGENT in `questions.md` with the fix: restore those files with `git checkout --`. The next run only needs to re-run `shipq.sh cw-kicksniper` once they are back. I haven't done the optional death-punch and sound-timing passes.

TASK PARTIAL: cw-kicksniper (Longshot kick 4.5 to 7.0) passed preflight but is not shipped; waiting on the p3069.ps1 restore.
